title: Impact of Zika Outbreak on Singapore Economy
what_it_is: Impact of Zika Outbreak on Singapore Economy

sections.label: Zika travel and economy impact
sections.summary: Singapore remains a safe travel destination with no WHO travel restriction, and the Government is acting to contain Zika and its possible economic impact.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: Singapore remains a safe travel destination, and there is no travel restriction by the World Health Organization to Zika-affected areas.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: The Government is taking strong coordinated actions to contain the Zika outbreak and any possible impact it might have on the economy.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: Zika's impact on visitor arrivals is currently contained.

sections.label: Business support schemes for Zika
sections.summary: Businesses can tap existing schemes, including SPRING Singapore's Working Capital Loan and the BCM programme, while agencies monitor developments and may activate further support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: While it is too early to consider Zika-specific support measures for businesses, they can tap on existing schemes if needed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: For example, small and medium enterprises facing short-term cash flow issues may apply for the Working Capital Loan programme administered by Standards, Productivity and Innovation Board (SPRING Singapore), which provides loans of up to $300,000.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: To ensure enterprise resilience in the event that operations are affected, SPRING Singapore is working with the Singapore Business Federation to help companies develop business continuity plans under the ongoing business continuity management (BCM) programme.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: Page: 25 The Ministry of Trade and Industry and its agencies will continue to closely monitor developments through the Ministry of Health and the National Environment Agency and are prepared to develop and activate further support for businesses should these prove necessary.

sections.label: No decline in arrivals
sections.summary: Discussions with stakeholders show no clear indication or trend of decline in arrivals.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: At the moment, our discussions with stakeholders indicate that there is no clear indication or trend of decline in arrivals.
